text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm about to eat lunch, when... I smell
something
out of this world!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
HAH-HAHAHA! Success! I've really
outdone
myself now! What an amazing
class representative
I am!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Only I could make a sandwich as amazing and fantastic as this!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Cough! Cough! Smells like something's burning! Is everything all right, Bakushin O?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Well, if it isn't Flower, my fellow
genius!
Everything's A-OK in here!
You're just in time to
see my culinary
masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Then all that black stuff is... Never mind.
So you
cooked this? This... uh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've boiled an egg... for an egg
sandwich!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The whole class shall be invigorated by
my
gourmet Bakushin-style cooking!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Bakushin-style... cooking?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Cooking is all about speed, you
see!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The flames go whoosh! And the oil spits up! And at the end you turn the heat to max and PRESTO! You've boiled an egg!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Sounds amazing,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Is that really how you boil... Ah, yes. I... I
see...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Speed is important, isn't it? Nothing beats a piping-hot meal.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But, um... Something tells me that's not
all there is
to cooking...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What? It's not?! But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, wait. I get it now! Completely! Truly!

One-hundred percent!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew... That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What you're saying is, to merely
Bakushin is not
enough. I must Bakushin
to the max!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll start over at once!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Uh, what?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Throw everything into the frying pan!
Then turn
the heat to high... No!
EXTREME SUPER MAX!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Uh, um, ah! I think it's better if you just
follow the
recip—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BAAAM!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Are you all right?!
